description: Changes one booking: the customer's details (party, name, email, phone, notes, answers), or its time with start (and resource), which moves it. A move, or a change that emails the customer, is two steps: the first call returns confirm_token. force books a clash anyway.

answers.description: {question id: answer} for the settings' questions ("" removes one)

confirm_token.description: From the first call, after the user's yes

notify_customer.description: Email the customer (default true when there is an email)

resource.description: With start: staff or room id or name

start.description: A new time: local "2026-10-15T14:00" (booking time zone)

name: edit_booking
title: Change a booking
